info.title: TopicAI
info.description: TopicAI — AI驱动的短视频创作选题助手，提供热点选题推荐、病毒性分析、标题优化、内容风险评估和发布建议等创作全链路智能服务。

get.description:
Overall system health check.

Returns basic service status and version info.
No authentication required.

Returns:
    JSON response with status, version, and uptime info.

Check LLM provider availability.

Returns status for each configured LLM provider.
No authentication required.

Returns:
    JSON response with per-provider availability status.

post.description:
Register a new user account.

Args:
    req: FastAPI request (for shared DB access).
    request: Registration details (email, username, password).

Returns:
    User info with JWT tokens.

Authenticate a user and return JWT tokens.

Args:
    req: FastAPI request (for shared DB access).
    request: Login credentials (email, password).

Returns:
    JWT access and refresh tokens.

Refresh an expired access token.

Args:
    req: FastAPI request (for shared DB access).
    request: Refresh token.

Returns:
    New access token.

get.description:
Get the currently authenticated user's information.

Returns:
    Current user details.

post.description:
Submit onboarding answers and generate a creator profile.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request object.
    data: Onboarding answers (track, content_formats, etc.).

Returns:
    Created CreatorProfile with 201 status.

get.description:
Get the current user's creator profile.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request object.
    user: Current authenticated user (injected by Depends).

Returns:
    User's CreatorProfile or 404 if not found.

put.description:
Update the current user's creator profile.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request object.
    data: Fields to update.
    user: Current authenticated user (injected by Depends).

Returns:
    Updated profile confirmation.

get.description:
Return persisted feedback records for the current user (Spec-007 T057).

Read-only view of ``user_feedback`` for personalization audits and
the on-device feedback history. The Pydantic ``FeedbackRecord``
model validates each row at the router boundary.

post.description: Refresh topic recommendations (get a new batch).

get.description: Explain why a topic was recommended.

Return recently recommended topics (Spec-007 US2 T046).

Spec-007 marks /topics/history as future-接入; this implementation
serves the cached output of the most recent /topics/recommend call
(DataManager.cache_recent_topics). When nothing has been cached
yet, returns an empty list with a meta marker.

post.description: Analyze viral/爆款 content (text or image).

get.description: Get a previous viral analysis result.

post.description: Boost a fuzzy idea into a structured content plan.

Create a blind prediction for content performance before publishing.

Spec-007 US4 (T062): delegates to ``EffectReviewService.create_prediction``
which calls ``EffectReviewChain.predict`` and INSERTs into
``effect_reviews`` (status='awaiting_actuals').

Returns 201 Created per the spec-007 contract.

Analyze the attribution of content performance after publishing.

Spec-007 US4 (T063): delegates to ``EffectReviewService.attribute``
which calls ``EffectReviewChain.attribute`` and UPDATEs the
``effect_reviews`` row with actual_result / attribution / learnings
(status='attributed').

Returns 201 Created.

get.description:
Aggregate the user's recent learnings (Spec-007 T066 + US4 T060).

Scans the user's ``effect_reviews`` within ``window_days`` and
surfaces the top recurring strengths and weaknesses. Returns a
``LearningsPayload`` shape, validated at the boundary.

List effect reviews for the current user (Spec-007 T066).

Returns persisted reviews from the ``effect_reviews`` table,
newest first. The Pydantic ``EffectReview`` model validates each
row at the boundary.

post.description:
Check content for compliance risks (Spec-007 T074).

Delegates to ``ContentRiskService.check`` and validates the result
with the ``ContentRiskReport`` Pydantic model. The response
``meta.ai_quality`` carries the required AI transparency fields
(``confidence`` / ``data_source`` / ``model_version``) per
Constitution Principle III.

ApiResponse.title: ApiResponse
ApiResponse.description:
Unified API response format.

All TopicAI API responses use this format:
{code, data, message, meta}

Attributes:
    code: HTTP status code.
    data: Response payload (can be None for errors).
    message: Human-readable message.
    meta: Additional metadata (AI quality, pagination, etc.).

EffectAttributeRequest.title: EffectAttributeRequest
EffectAttributeRequest.description:
Schema for attribution request (post-publish).

Attributes:
    review_id: The EffectReview ID from the prediction step.
    actual_data: Actual performance metrics.

EffectPredictRequest.title: EffectPredictRequest
EffectPredictRequest.description:
Schema for blind prediction request.

Attributes:
    topic_title: The topic/title to predict performance for.
    content_outline: Optional content outline for context.

FeedbackSubmitRequest.title: FeedbackSubmitRequest
FeedbackSubmitRequest.description:
Schema for submitting feedback.

Attributes:
    target_type: 'topic', 'viral', 'title', or 'idea'.
    target_id: ID of the AI output.
    feedback_type: 'thumb_up', 'thumb_down', 'adopted', 'modified', 'ignored'.
    reason: Optional reason for the feedback.

IdeaBoostRequest.title: IdeaBoostRequest
IdeaBoostRequest.description:
Schema for idea boost request.

Attributes:
    idea: The fuzzy idea text to crystallize.

OnboardingRequest.title: OnboardingRequest
OnboardingRequest.description:
Schema for onboarding submission.

Attributes:
    track: Selected content track.
    content_formats: Preferred content formats.
    production_complexity: Production complexity level.
    content_depth: Content depth preference.
    hotspot_preference: Hotspot preference.

ProfileUpdateRequest.title: ProfileUpdateRequest
ProfileUpdateRequest.description: Schema for updating a creator profile (all fields optional).

PublishSuggestRequest.title: PublishSuggestRequest
PublishSuggestRequest.description:
Schema for publish time suggestion request.

Attributes:
    platform: Target platform.
    content_type: Content type.

RiskCheckRequest.title: RiskCheckRequest
RiskCheckRequest.description:
Schema for content risk check request.

Attributes:
    content: The content text to check for risks.

TitleOptimizeRequest.title: TitleOptimizeRequest
TitleOptimizeRequest.description:
Schema for title optimization request.

Attributes:
    title: The original title to optimize.
    content_summary: Optional summary of the content.

TopicRecommendRequest.title: TopicRecommendRequest
TopicRecommendRequest.description:
Schema for topic recommendation request.

Attributes:
    mode: Recommendation mode ('hotspot_fusion' or 'evergreen_deep').
    track: Optional track override (defaults to user profile track).

TrackDiagnoseRequest.title: TrackDiagnoseRequest
TrackDiagnoseRequest.description:
Schema for track diagnosis request.

Attributes:
    track_keyword: The track keyword to diagnose.

ViralAnalyzeRequest.title: ViralAnalyzeRequest
ViralAnalyzeRequest.description:
Schema for viral analysis request.

Attributes:
    input_type: 'text' or 'image'.
    content: Text content or image URL/base64.
